anope_sql_engine.description: The name of the SQL engine block to use for Chanstats. Must match an existing engine definition in the Anope config.

anope_db_prefix.description: An optional prefix prepended to the name of each created database table.

anope_ns_def_chanstats.description: Enable Chanstats for newly registered nicks. Valid values: yes, no.

anope_cs_def_chanstats.description: Enable Chanstats for newly registered channels. Valid values: yes, no.
